briefdescription.para: MatchCoprocessorOperandName - Try to parse an coprocessor related instruction with a symbolic operand name.

detaileddescription.para: We accept "crN" syntax for GAS compatibility. <operand-name> ::= <prefix><number> If CoprocOp is 'c', then: <prefix> ::= c | cr If CoprocOp is 'p', then : <prefix> ::= p <number> ::= integer in range [0, 15]
